Plex directly needs atlas (its Docker host) and the tank pool (library and appdata); through atlas it also depends on apc-1 for power and gate for email notifications, and tank exists only while atlas runs.
If titan is off, the Ollama endpoint on it stops (direct), and wiki-search degrades: new pages are not embedded, though keyword search still works (second hop).

The nightly rclone backup directly needs atlas (it runs there), tank (it reads the 05:45 snapshot) and gate (internet access to upload); indirectly it needs apc-1 for power, and gate and tank through atlas.

The hermes VM directly needs atlas (it runs on atlas) and tank (its vdisk is on tank/domains and it cannot boot without tank); through atlas it also needs apc-1 for power and gate for email notifications.

Syncing notes to pebble stops. Syncthing runs as a container on atlas, so it stops directly; it also depends on tank, which exists only while atlas runs, and on tailscale, which runs on atlas and is the only route to pebble.

If gate goes down, these lose function directly: aria (network features), atlas (Unraid email notifications), rclone-backup (internet upload), reverse-proxy (outside access on port 443) and tailscale (internet access). Second hop via atlas and tailscale: hermes, plex, rclone-backup, reverse-proxy, syncthing, tank, pebble (remote access) and syncthing (sync to pebble).

Keyword queries need wiki-search to run, which directly needs hermes (the VM it runs on) and ollama-endpoint (for embeddings, though keyword search still works without it). Indirectly it needs atlas and tank through hermes, and titan through the ollama-endpoint.

If atlas shuts down, the pool tank stops (it exists only while atlas runs), and the hosts and services stop directly: hermes VM, plex, rclone-backup, reverse-proxy, syncthing and tailscale. Second hop: wiki-search stops with hermes, and pebble loses remote access and Syncthing sync, since both go through tailscale.

If tank is unavailable while atlas runs, these stop: hermes VM (cannot boot without its vdisk on tank), plex (library and appdata on tank), rclone-backup (reads the tank snapshot) and syncthing (syncs the tank/notes share). Second hop: wiki-search stops because it runs on hermes.

If hermes is down, wiki-search stops, since it runs on hermes next to the wiki repo; its index timer and search service are lost, and new pages are not indexed. Hermes itself needs atlas and tank, so those do not depend on it.
